# uk-short-term-let-regulations-2026

> Structured, source-linked data on UK short-term let licensing (November 2026): Scotland licence by council (all 32 councils), Wales visitor accommodation registration, England short-term let register. Every record carries an official source URL and a last-checked date. Reference only, not legal advice.

## Data

- [Scotland — all 32 councils (JSON)](data/scotland-councils.json): licence required, control area, fee range, fine, planning note, source, last checked.
- [Wales — 19 rules (JSON)](data/wales.json): registration deadline 2027-03-31 (free, Welsh Revenue Authority), late penalty £100, visitor levy £1.30/75p, licensing likely 2029, statutory default 4 March 2030, C3/C5/C6 planning, 252/182-day business rates tests.
- [England — 11 rules (JSON)](data/england.json): national register expected March 2027 (not yet open), Greater London 90-night cap, planning case-by-case, 140/70-day business rates tests.
- [Summary — all 62 records (CSV)](data/summary.csv)
- [JSON Schema](data/schema.json): validates the three data files.

## Docs

- [How to use the data](docs/how-to-use.md): field definitions, examples, citation guidance.
- [Sources](docs/sources.md): every official source, grouped by jurisdiction.
- [Safety requirements (England)](docs/safety-requirements.md): fire, gas, electrical, insurance, EPC summaries.
- [Compliance checklist](docs/compliance-checklist.md): tick-box checklist by jurisdiction (Scotland / Wales / England / general safety), every item sourced.
- [JSON-LD guide](docs/jsonld-guide.md): how to use the templates, replace placeholders, validate with Google's Rich Results Test.

## Tools

- [Commission savings calculator](tools/commission-savings-calculator.html): self-contained HTML/JS, no backend. Annual and 3-year saving plus payback months against the £1,999 one-time build fee; OTA 15% example rate, Stripe 1.5% + 20p standard UK cards.

## Templates

- [LodgingBusiness / BedAndBreakfast JSON-LD](templates/lodgingbusiness-jsonld.json): schema.org template with licenceNumber field (replace EXAMPLE- values).
- [FAQPage JSON-LD](templates/faq-schema.json): 7 licensing questions.
- [Hotel JSON-LD](templates/hotel-jsonld.json): schema.org Hotel template with licenceNumber field.
- [HowTo JSON-LD](templates/howto-jsonld.json): "How to apply for a Scotland short-term let licence" steps.
- [Organization + Service JSON-LD](templates/organization-jsonld.json): business template with licenceNumber placeholder and published directbook.uk prices.

## Scripts

- [Validation script](scripts/validate.py): `python3 scripts/validate.py` — checks all data files against the schema.
- [Monthly update checklist](scripts/update-check.md): what to re-check each month (England register opening, Wales deadline).

## Maintainer

- [directbook.uk](https://directbook.uk/): commission-free direct-booking websites for UK B&Bs and holiday lets. Every site includes a visible licence / registration number field.
- [UK short-term rental regulations — overview](https://directbook.uk/short-term-rental-regulations/)
- [Scotland short-term let licence](https://directbook.uk/scotland-short-term-let-licence/)
- [Wales holiday let registration](https://directbook.uk/wales-holiday-let-registration/)
- [England short-term let register](https://directbook.uk/england-short-term-let-register/)

## Notes

- A `null` value means the official source has not published that figure — never an estimate.
- `verification: direct-read` means the official page was opened and read; `search-verified` means the official page was quoted verbatim via search results.
- Last updated: 2026-11-16. Version: v1.1.0 (unreleased; v1.0.0 released 2026-11-16).
